fieldData.full-article-text:
You cannot move stake freely between validators as this would undermine network security - creating loopholes where stake could be removed from malicious validators without incurring any penalties.

If you wished to change validators, you would have to unstake and restake as follows:

  • submit a request to unstake your tokens;
  • at the next epoch boundary, you will stop earning rewards;
  • the network will then spend up to a period of a few weeks assessing whether your validator was malicious while your tokens were staked, such as double-voting (on betanet this period will be much shorter for testing purposes);
  • once the network determines nothing malicious was performed, your tokens will then be unstaked, and you will be free to do whatever you want with them, including staking to another validator.

This is why it’s important to make an informed decision about the validators that you choose.

You can read more about how to stake tokens here.

You can read more about how to unstake tokens here.
